source: STUB — Kentro CSF Playbook Step 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3. Real tier questionnaires (HIGH 15Q / MOD 12Q / LOW 8Q) ship with Eugene's reference data CSV.

high.label: HIGH (FIPS 199)
high.intro: Tier-HIGH systems carry the strictest confidentiality / integrity / availability bar. Questions probe full-program rigor.

questions.stem: Walk us through your full enterprise risk management program and how cybersecurity rolls up to executive oversight.

moderate.label: MODERATE (FIPS 199)
moderate.intro: Tier-MOD systems have meaningful business impact but tolerate brief outages. Questions probe established practices.

questions.stem: Walk us through your cybersecurity policy framework and how it's reviewed.

low.label: LOW (FIPS 199)
low.intro: Tier-LOW systems have limited adverse-impact exposure. Questions probe baseline hygiene only.

questions.stem: Walk us through what cybersecurity practices the team relies on day-to-day.
